scope: Targeted claim-support and identity review of all 39 journal references; not a full-text review of every source or independent experimental reproduction
limitations: The Axelsson publisher full text was not obtained; the broad claim is limited to base-rate sensitivity.
No commercial similarity database or AI detector was accessed.
Author approvals and declarations remain deferred at the user request.
